verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway/Insomnia docs mention privacy-oriented controls like local model processing ('Local models keep processing fully on your machine for privacy and control') and secret vaults that keep data out of plaintext, which touch on data-privacy posture, but there is no explicit feature or documentation describing preventing user data from being used to train downstream AI models when proxied through Kong AI Gateway. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out/no-training data governance policy for LLM traffic routed through AI Gateway, contractual or technical guarantees against training use, and independent corroboration of such a feature.
